com.sun.xml.internal.stream.buffer

类 AttributesHolder

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.xml.internal.stream.buffer.AttributesHolder
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Attributes

    public final class AttributesHolder
extends Object
implements Attributes
    Class for holding attributes. Since it implements Attributes, this class follows the SAX convention of using "" instead of null.

      • getType

        public final String getType(int index)
        从接口复制的说明: Attributes
        Look up an attribute's type by index.

        The attribute type is one of the strings "CDATA", "ID", "IDREF", "IDREFS", "NMTOKEN", "NMTOKENS", "ENTITY", "ENTITIES", or "NOTATION" (always in upper case).

        If the parser has not read a declaration for the attribute, or if the parser does not report attribute types, then it must return the value "CDATA" as stated in the XML 1.0 Recommendation (clause 3.3.3, "Attribute-Value Normalization").

        For an enumerated attribute that is not a notation, the parser will report the type as "NMTOKEN".

        指定者:
        getType 在接口中 Attributes
        参数:
        index - The attribute index (zero-based).
        返回:
        The attribute's type as a string, or null if the index is out of range.
        另请参阅:
        Attributes.getLength()

      • getValue

        public final String getValue(int index)
        从接口复制的说明: Attributes
        Look up an attribute's value by index.

        If the attribute value is a list of tokens (IDREFS, ENTITIES, or NMTOKENS), the tokens will be concatenated into a single string with each token separated by a single space.

        指定者:
        getValue 在接口中 Attributes
        参数:

        The attribute's value as a string, or null if the index is out of range.
